steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: With the results of the referendum, the Great Aquapit will soon complete its historic half-year mission. It will be blown up and turned into construction material once again.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Citizens, I'm afraid this slightly extended summer carnival will soon come to an end.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: *sobs*... I'll always remember our beautiful time together forever.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: But the super slide is so much fun, you can't get enough of it! I never thought we'd have to say goodbye...

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: However! In the Great Aquapit's place, we'll have an all-new, prettier, and completely different structure! After all, this is Zeruertza, a city built by the best architectural designers!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Stitch Canvas and Catch Lightrace are two awe-inspiring, up-and-coming architectural designers. Over the next few months, the two of them will submit their design proposals...

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Imagine the show showdown they have in store for us.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Hehe, this brings me back to the dome design contest they had a few years ago, when they just made their debuts!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: The duel ended all those years ago without a winner, but who will win the right to design Zeruertza's next landmark? Let us—

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Let me get a sip of water first.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Croque, I've never seen you so enthusiastic. Have you been drinking?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: No. Not yet, at least.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Now this isn't like you at all.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I was watching videos of a competition on the surface that I got from Inam, and it seems they have a role called 'the MC'.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I thought I might dip into a new career path.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Anyhow! Although the architects' designs are yet to come, my fellow citizens, the tail end of our summer is going to be a fleeting one!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Before the slide is blown up, let us enjoy it all we can!

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Ohhhh!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tomimi, watch out! Slow down!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I was so, so jealous when I heard you guys went to the waterfall in Acahualla!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Hehe, and this time I get to join in on the fun!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You're such a kid.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? What's wrong? You're usually so careful to hide your tail. Let's see... Did it get thicker again?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Eh? Nope, not even a little! I checked with a measuring tape before I got here! It's been months since I got any thicker!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh? Sounds like you're really hung up on it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Waaaahhh... Eat my water blast!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Heh, you little runt! It's on!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: They're more like Durins than you are.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: How would you know what it means to be 'Durin', Lupo?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: You seem a little nervous. Are you worried about your contest with Catch?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Worried? Over him? Don't make me laugh. I haven't fallen so low. It's just laypeople tend to like his proposals more.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Mine get their fair share of fans, too. Perhaps I should be bringing something different to the table. That's how I'll win.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Perhaps I should just... *sigh*! I should probably take my mind off of that right now.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: To tell the truth... if we don't care about aesthetics and just look at how fun it is, this 'Great Aquapit' isn't so bad.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Oh, so you enjoy these things, too?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Every now and then.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Stitch, you're here!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Want to try out the slide with the downstream speed set to max? It wears the equipment out, so we don't usually get to do it.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: I just tried it a couple times with Elysium. It was amazingly fast!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: It does hurt a little when you hit the water, though. Still, wanna try?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: No, thanks. I'm not one bit interested in fun and games like...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Whooo! Bombs away!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Catch, my brother! This impact force is on another level! Did you see how high that splash went?!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Maybe we should try something different. Say... see which of us can land with the tiniest splash?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Keep the splashes small? Good idea! Sounds like it won't hurt nearly as bad.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: My sand castle...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Hey, uh, Catch, did we perhaps... screw up?)

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: (Uh, even though this is Stitch we're talking about, he can't possibly be mad over a sand castle, right?)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (He seems rather angry to me, though.)

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: (In that case, we should probably...)

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Hey, where are you two going? You're just going to run? Get back here!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Yep, you did very well getting everyone going.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I have your video tapes to thank. That's where I picked it up.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Next, we can hold a series of contests to keep the enthusiasm that goes with this 'championship' contest going, then we'll use Catch and Stitch's design contest in a few months to pump everyone up to the max.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: We could print some paper slips for the audience to use to show their support for one side, with prizes given to those who pick the right side.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: We call those lottery tickets. You're really good at picking things up. Up on the surface, there are merchants who line their pockets by selling them.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: We Durins don't much care for money in that way... Let's have the losing side pay for the winners' drinks for a month!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Hm, we could make it two months to make things more exciting, too. We'll have to decide with a referendum.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Later on, perhaps we could issue some more lottery tickets covering how many months' worth of alcohol are owed in the end.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I'm starting to worry about the Zeruertzans' future.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm, I'm not used to feeling unhelpful.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What's wrong? Do you have to beat something up to satisfy yourself?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Not really.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Still, if this goes well, Acahualla will get its hands on some Durin. Would've been a totally pointless trip otherwise.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial may have left home a long time ago, but she actually really cares about Acahualla!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, I've been to so many different places, but the rainforest is the one place where I feel most at home.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Are you going to come back, then?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Not planning on it. Not yet, at least. I still have lots of patients to take care of back at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: There are plenty of Tiacauh who want you to go back. You could think about becoming their lord ameer, even.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, and they want bananas to sprout straight out of the soil, too. Can't always get what you want.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Gavial, you would be the most fitting lord ameer for Acahualla. You are the only one who can rein in each and every Tiacauh.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Everyone is awaiting your return.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: And if you simply cannot do it, then it's ultimately likely... that a lord ameer from the Court of Sargon will come to govern Acahualla instead.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: And when that happens, Acahualla will no longer be the free land you knew.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But don't we already have you for our Great Chief?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: There are some things I can't do anything about.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I can come up with ideas to help get us in better shape, but I'm not the one who can really bring the Tiacauh together.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's not like I'm running away from responsibility here, Inam.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's just... I haven't thought through how to actually do it.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You know how to think? Color me surprised.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, Zumama, you picking a fight?!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What I'm saying is, you usually do stuff without thinking.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: And that's fine when it's just me, but this is about all those Tiacauh...

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: All good things must come to an end. Isn't that right? So this giant slide will be torn down for something new.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: I actually didn't catch much of what you were talking about. All I want to say is, my friends, let me get a picture of all of you together while it's still standing.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha, alright, let's toss all this complicated stuff aside for now.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Right now, we gotta have fun!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tomimi, you gimme a smile, too!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Looks like you've mastered the Durin philosophy.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, it's not often we get a vacation. As if I'm gonna waste it!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Well said! Here's to you! How about some berry tomato wine? It's on me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Nah, I'll have to pass on that.

a.text: The demolition explosives have already been set, and the assistant robots have made all the preparations.
Soon, the big water slide that has brought everyone so much joy will be gone without a trace.
But summer must come to an end, and there will no doubt be greater fun in the future.
That's what all the Zeruertzans believe.
The explosion isn't nearly as loud as anyone expects. The slide simply slowly disintegrates.
Or perhaps, a little more poetically, it melts into the water.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: My, what a graceful way to disappear.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Here I thought you would pass out from all that drink and miss the demolition.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Haha, I know how to have a good time.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Though, at times like these, I generally keep myself clearheaded.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: That's the most basic respect I have for things as they fade away.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Whoa, were you actually a secret genius? That would be such a cheap cliche, even in the Zeruertzan library.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, you little rascal!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Stitch.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Catch...

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: It's time we got serious. Let's both do our best, fair and square.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Shake hands if you agree?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Alright... Out of the most basic respect for another Zeruertzan.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Say, you two actually get along pretty well, don't you?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: What, are you blind?! Where'd you get that idea?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Now, things are going to get real from here on out!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Has Croque been drinking...?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: The warm-up of warm-ups, the prelude to preludes! The first season of the Zeruertza Competition Series!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: *Drumroll*—Ta-dah! A swimming contest!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: How about it?
